limitations: Point-in-time observations, not reservations or resource enforcement.
No model offload configuration inferred from GPU memory.

enforcement.max_gpu_bytes: advisory: no GPU allocation isolation or offload configuration
enforcement.model_context_tokens: AI request budget; actual tokenization belongs to the provider
enforcement.max_workers: orchestrator scheduling limit; no global process isolation
enforcement.build_parallelism: adapter-specific; only effective when a builder consumes it
enforcement.execution_timeout_seconds: adapter-specific timeout; no guarantee for detached child processes
enforcement.max_retries: orchestrator retry limit; zero disables automatic recovery
